statement: Zilber–Pink in abelian varieties and the Siegel threefold. Proves the abelian Zilber–Pink conjecture over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$: every irreducible subvariety has finitely many maximal atypical subvarieties relative to its smallest containing torsion coset. It also proves the full curve case in the Siegel threefold $`\mathcal A_2`$ for Hodge-generic curves defined over $`\overline{\mathbb Q}`$, without boundary or reduction assumptions.
